incident_details.title: High Risk Alerts: ESA for 192.168.10.14
incident_details.description: The alert shows network traffic from 192.168.10.14 to broadcast/multicast destinations (255.255.255.255 and 239.255.255.250) with no supporting endpoint, process, or PowerShell evidence. This pattern is suspicious and may indicate abnormal discovery or service chatter, but there is no direct evidence of compromise or exfiltration.
